links.outcome: Starting and total FSH dose and MII oocytes with vs without AI decision support
links.effect: MII oocytes 11.17 vs 11.25; starting FSH 397.09 vs 443.84 IU; total FSH 4,181.77 vs 4,654.71 IU; no adverse events introduced by AI.
links.quote: Physician use of AI helped significantly reduce the starting and total FSH doses prescribed to patients without adversely affecting MII outcomes, indicating the potential use of AI in lowering in vitro fertilization costs to patients.

screen.reason: Evaluates real-world clinical deployment and patient outcomes of an AI clinical decision support tool for ovarian stimulation dose and timing, comparing AI-assisted practice to historical control.
